faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our China market entry services

items.question: What makes your service different from traditional marketing agencies?
items.answer: We provide authentic community-driven growth instead of paid ads. Our 100+ AI communities and 20+ city presence give you direct access to real developers and tech enthusiasts, not just impressions.

items.question: How quickly can you help us launch in China?
items.answer: Typically 2-4 weeks from initial consultation to campaign launch. We handle everything: market research, community outreach, content localization, and user feedback collection.

items.question: Do you only work with AI products?
items.answer: While AI products are our specialty, we also work with Web3, developer tools, and hardware products that target China's tech community. If your product serves developers or tech enthusiasts, we can help.

items.question: Can you help with hardware manufacturing?
items.answer: Yes! We connect you with China's hardware supply chain for rapid prototyping and manufacturing. From PCB design to final assembly, we facilitate the entire process.

items.question: What's your pricing model?
items.answer: We offer flexible engagement models: project-based, retainer, or revenue-share partnerships. Contact us to discuss what works best for your needs and budget.
